summary: Observation sheets for investigation OT-10-S0019, the seven-day exploratory rat dose-range finding and recovery work for Nimbravelle Medicines Inc (NM-31). Individual-animal identifiers are kept on every observation line. Doses are in mg/kg/day; dose-lot concentrations were recorded on the preparation sheet, with the older vehicle-only lots still logged in the legacy units. The findings set the dose range for Nimbravelle's planned longer study.
